required: Preserve translator/publisher attribution, work title, immutable revision/source path, licence URL and complete applicable notice.
Noncommercial use; adaptations shared under compatible BY-NC-SA terms, with changes/extraction disclosed and no implied endorsement.
Bodies, original notes, prefaces and summaries remain live-only; package only metadata and integrity hashes.
Scope approval covers textual notes and apparatus only; no audio, images, media, third-party trademark/font or new hosting approval.
changes_notice: Presentation extraction only: remove reviewed Markdown heading/emphasis markers and abbreviation tags; unescape literal bracket and cross-reference punctuation; render only the fourteen exact publisher253/254/256 owner-bound Pandoc display alternatives using their original diacritics-on C/c text; replace original note references with explicit note labels; remove Markdown hard-break padding while preserving every line and paragraph. Preserve wording, typography, diacritics, brackets, uncertainty, both numbering systems, both colophons and all original notes. Keep publisher251 chapter preface separate and note-free. No source wording is generated, repaired or harmonized to VRI; no Pali peyyala is expanded. Complete publisher-edition poems are not line-complete VRI translations.
edition_statement: Follows PTS with explicit BJTS corrections/alternatives and translator interpretations. Do not claim this equals every VRI line.
